prayer.title: After Lunch — published order (1982)
prayer.locator: Prayers at the Table, printed pp.34–35

blocks.locator: Prayers at the Table, printed p.34

blocks.text: We thank Thee, Christ our God, for Thou hast satisfied us with Thine earthly gifts. Deprive us not of Thy Heavenly Kingdom, but as Thou camest among Thy disciples, O Savior, giving them peace, so come to us and save us!
blocks.locator: Prayers at the Table, printed p.34–35

blocks.text: Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever and unto ages of ages. Amen.
blocks.locator: Prayers at the Table, printed p.35
Prayers at the Table, printed p.35

blocks.text: Blessed is God, Who has had mercy on us and fed us from His rich gifts, through His Grace and love for mankind, always, now and ever and unto ages of ages. Amen.
blocks.locator: Prayers at the Table, printed p.35

sources.rightsNote: The official Project Gutenberg catalogue and preserved metadata designate this edition public domain in the USA. This does not assert public-domain status worldwide. The introduction identifies its Psalms as RSV-based; those Psalm passages are excluded here. Morning Prayers and Compline are not presented as complete native rules because their Psalm passages were not reproduced. The full 1982 wording and sequence of included prayer units is retained, including historical OCA jurisdictional titles, source rubrics, and liturgical alternatives. This is not the 2019 St. Tikhon’s edition or the user’s Mother of God Church rule.
